mission: Build and ship AshenSpire as a repository-native, provider-neutral, token-efficient multi-agent game-development project under centralized control and decentralized execution.
measurable_end_state: A playable, hosted, released AshenSpire whose every delivery fact traces to an exact Git object, produced by disposable agents that recover from a clean clone with zero evidence loss and zero duplicate authority.
non_negotiable_invariants: Git history and validated machine state are authoritative; dashboards, chat, and model memory are projections only.
One writer per overlapping path or ref.
Reversible work proceeds by default; gates exist only for genuine protected boundaries.
No push, PR, merge, deploy, publication, or release without its own exact separate authority.
An OWNER_OVERRIDE is recorded separately from the underlying evidence result and never fabricates a PASS or impersonates an independent reviewer.

default_autonomy.description: Team Leads and agents perform reversible, collision-free local work (read-only inspection, scoped local implementation, isolated refs/worktrees, tests, builds, schema validation, fixtures, documentation, local commits on isolated branches) without routine approval waits.

deputy.grant_summary: Near-owner operational authority to translate owner intent into execution within these explicit, machine-readable grants.
included_actions: assign or rebind bounded reversible work
resolve ordinary technical, routing, delegation, and integration decisions without additional approval loops
accept bounded technical risk with recorded evidence
integrate to dev through the normal reviewable PR process at its discretion
chair a temporary QA Coordination Pool while a collision holds
excluded_actions: delegate broader authority than it holds
change Pages source, tag, publish, or declare final release readiness
deputy.supersession: A later owner-intent commit supersedes this grant; the source commit is the Git commit that introduced the record.
deputy.non_amplifying_rule: effective grant = delegator grant ∩ task ∩ resource/ref/path ∩ action ∩ time

protected_decision_classes: direct update to dev or main
destructive cleanup, reset, deletion, or history rewrite
credential, privacy, or security boundary crossing
override of an independent QA verdict

override_rules.recording: An exact owner directive is recorded as OWNER_OVERRIDE, separate from the underlying evidence result, referencing the exact object and the evidence it overrides.
override_rules.invalidation: An override is invalidated when its referenced exact object identity (ref/head/tree/hash) changes; a changed object requires a fresh directive.
forbidden: bypass external credentials or platform controls
